memoryMaintenance.title: Memory maintenance history
memoryMaintenance.boundary: These are recorded checks of the shared-memory search index. They describe past attempts; they do not establish current readiness or the quality of the stored knowledge.
memoryMaintenance.empty: No shared-memory index checks are recorded. Other maintenance operations are not included.
memoryMaintenance.unavailable: Current Memory maintenance history could not be checked. Reload your account or retry the read.
memoryMaintenance.bounded: Showing the ten newest index-check attempts. Older attempts remain with Memory.

explanation.queued: The original worker has not started this attempt.
explanation.running: The index check is in progress. No verified result has been recorded yet.
explanation.unconfirmed: The time limit expired without a confirmed result. This does not establish failure or authorize another attempt.
explanation.review_required: The attempt ended without a verified index check. Review it through Memory before deciding what to do next.
explanation.verified_index_check: Memory recorded a native index check and statistics refresh with a matching verification receipt. This is a historical fact.
explanation.verification_unavailable: The job ended, but its matching native verification receipt could not be established. Success is not confirmed.
explanation.source_unavailable: The original source binding is no longer available. No source details or verified result are shown.

measures.title: Activation measures
measures.boundary: These measures describe your current onboarding and independently verified result. They do not establish usability targets or measure all setup actions.
measures.unavailable: Activation measures could not be loaded. Check your current account and company, then try again.
measures.creationToVerification: Time from onboarding creation to verified result
measures.bounded: There are more recorded transitions than this bounded view can inspect. A complete count is unavailable.
measures.baselineUnavailable: Unavailable: the usable-account start point has not been established. Onboarding creation is a different measure.
measures.processing: This private view uses existing records and stores no separate analytics dataset. Source changes can withdraw prior measures.

state.verified: A current independently verified result is recorded.
state.not_recorded: No verified result is recorded yet.
state.withdrawn: The original result is no longer currently verified. Prior measures are unavailable.

duration.thirty_minutes_to_two_hours: Thirty minutes to under two hours
duration.two_hours_to_day: Two hours to under one day

agentMonitorPausedWorkBoundary: Pause stops new autonomous work and preserves the agent configuration and history. Check existing work separately.
agentMonitorPauseCancelPolicy: Pause in Advanced requests cancellation of active native runs. A paused status alone does not confirm that a remote process stopped or that its task finished.

agentMonitorPausedWork.none: No pending native runs were recorded at this check. This does not confirm that remote work has stopped.
agentMonitorPausedWork.pending_one: {{count}} pending native run remains. Review its original run controls.
agentMonitorPausedWork.pending_other: {{count}} pending native runs remain. Review their original run controls.
agentMonitorPausedWork.unavailable: Pending work could not be fully checked. Review the original run controls before treating the agent as settled.

retirement.title: Retire {{name}}
retirement.boundary: Retirement permanently stops new work by this agent and removes the local access listed below. Configuration, completed work and audit history follow the existing company retention policy. Connected services and unresolved work must be handled first.
retirement.alreadyStopped: This agent was previously stopped. Its full retirement and access cleanup still require review.
retirement.completed: Retirement is confirmed. The listed local access was removed. No external service was contacted by this operation.
retirement.ready: The current review has no outstanding retirement requirements.
retirement.accessUnavailable: A complete access count is unavailable. Retirement is blocked until all access can be reviewed.
retirement.confirm: I have reviewed the current requirements and local access. Permanently retire this agent and keep its history under the existing company policy.
retirement.unavailable: Retirement controls are unavailable. Recheck your account and current access.
retirement.unconfirmed: The retirement request could not be confirmed. Check the current state, or retry the same request. Your confirmation does not authorize a different request.

blocker.pause_required: Pause this agent before reviewing retirement.
blocker.work_pending: Settle or reassign outstanding work, requests and unresolved actions through their original controls.
blocker.automation_connected: Remove this agent from connected routines, pipelines and workflows before retiring it.
blocker.reports_pending: Reassign agents that report to this agent.
blocker.disconnect_required: Disconnect installed capabilities and provider access, and reconcile outstanding credentials through their original controls.
blocker.protected_agent: This built-in agent cannot be retired here.
blocker.source_limit: The access review exceeds the supported limit. Retirement cannot remove only part of its access.
blocker.disabled: New retirements are currently disabled in this instance.
